* Transparent Governance: Rules enforcing disclosure and local consent so that system operators cannot unilaterally suppress public interest data. * Verifiable Substrates: Content-derived identifiers and decentralized registries that preserve records independently of any single custodian. [1](https://independent.academia.edu/LSharks)
